title: Charge-Day Timetable: Late Fees of the Declined Period in a Storage Unit Card Catch-Up (Bluegate AutoPay Authorization)
content:
**Timetable rule.** The card catch-up charge on a storage unit agreement under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization adds the declined period's late fees as they will stand on the charge day, the day after the handling date:

- **the late fee plus the second late fee**, where a second late fee is posted for the declined due date, or the charge day is at least the second-late-fee day count (calendar days) after the declined due date;
- **the late fee alone**, where only a late fee is posted, or the charge day is more than the grace period (calendar days) after the declined due date;
- **nothing** otherwise.

"The late fee" is the late fee counted in the card catch-up charge. The tiers are tested in that order. Posted means a fee entry of that type on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement ledger whose period is the declined due date (the agreement's oldest unpaid due date).

| Unit class | Grace period (days) | Second-late-fee day count (days) | Second late fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | 5 | 15 | $15.00 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | 5 | 15 | $15.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | 5 | 15 | $15.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | 5 | 15 | $20.00 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | 7 | 20 | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | 7 | 20 | $25.00 |

### Both sides of each day count (hypothetical, Bluegate Drive-Up Standard, declined due date 1 May, no fee yet posted)

| Handling date | Charge day | Days from 1 May to the charge day | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 May | 6 May | 5 — not more than 5 | Nothing |
| 6 May | 7 May | 6 — more than 5 | Late fee |
| 14 May | 15 May | 14 — under 15 | Late fee |
| 15 May | 16 May | 15 — at least 15 | Late fee plus $15.00 |

On a Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault unit the same dates read against 7 and 20 days: a charge day of 8 May (7 days) adds nothing; 9 May (8 days) adds the late fee; 21 May (20 days) adds the late fee plus $25.00.

A second late fee already posted for the declined due date gives the first tier whatever the charge day; a late fee already posted gives at least the second tier.
